meta.source: MoSPI, NSS 80 Comprehensive Modular Survey: Education
meta.base: CMSE April–June 2025, school spending and coaching separate
meta.vintageNote: The MoSPI eSankhyiki response does not publish a data revision timestamp. Its archive capture date is recorded separately and must not be treated as the source revision date.
meta.revisionPolicy: These published administrative counts and survey estimates may be revised by the agency; changed responses are archived before rebaking.
meta.coverage: Distribution of students enrolled in school education by level of current enrolment: all published cross-tabs; gender, level of enrollment, sector, state
meta.note: Complete observed row grain from data/raw/schools/cmse-23.json. No Cartesian expansion or averaging of state ratios. Survey estimates describe currently enrolled students; state estimates require sample-size/RSE caution. Spending covers the current academic year; coaching is separate from school spending. Survey totals must not be extrapolated into population counts.
